query:
INSERT INTO members AS m
( member_number
, email
, first_name
, last_name
, language
, date_of_birth
, note
, address
, city
, postal_code
, phone_number
, registration_request_id
)
SELECT $2
, email
, first_name
, last_name
, registration_local
, date_of_birth
, note
, address
, city
, postal_code
, phone_number
, $1
FROM registration_requests as rr
WHERE rr.id = $1
RETURNING m.id
